units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (p. 257ᵃ ed. Amst.) (ref. to <he>נשק</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 140:8">Ps. CXL, 8</cite>) <he>כיום זִיּוּנָם של וכ׳</he> on the day when the thirty and one kings went to war against Joshua.
<cite ref="Menachot 29b:6">Men. 29ᵇ</cite> seven letters (in the Torah-scrolls) require <he>שלשה ז׳</he> each three crownlets (flourishes).
